name: flamingo
description: A flamingo with a curved neck, a bent bill and long wading legs.
useCase: Identify a flamingo, wetland wildlife or a wading bird.
misuse: Use a visible label when a bird identifies a category, service or place.

16.reason: The raised body leaves a long exposed standing leg and a separate folded leg. A small downward bill and curved neck preserve the flamingo silhouette.

24.reason: The narrow body, curved neck and long legs retain their natural proportions. The folded leg stays separate from the standing leg and the body opening remains clear.
